question: Which portion of occluded C10 error is predictable from existing information, lost by the current representation, or demonstrably ambiguous at identical published input?
scope: Diagnostic experiment only. Frozen C10 FIT-only models. Official VAL untouched. All artifacts in CC. No new final competition model.

concepts.X_raw: published whole heightmap, integer TX and receiver coordinate
concepts.X_extra: 103 receiver-neighbourhood/cell geometry descriptors of the same X_raw
concepts.Z_privileged: other band observed residual at the same receiver, diagnostic-only, unavailable at deployment

phase1: Audit all TRAIN exact H+TX repeats; compare labels and frozen predictions in joint-valid pixels. Empirical duplicate inconsistency is not an estimate of independent Monte-Carlo noise when seeds may be shared.

phase2.split: fixed seed20261102, half306 terrains calibration /half306 confirmation; no shared terrain, no confirmation-driven hyperparameter selection
phase2.input_points: existing256 uniformly sampled pixels per map, selected independently of labels/masks
phase2.learner: per-band LightGBM regression on out-of-sample C10 residual;400 fixed trees,31 leaves,max_depth8,min_data_in_leaf200,max_bin255,learning_rate.05,lambda_l2=1,feature_fraction1,bagging1,seed20261102,num_threads8. No early stopping.
phase2.evaluation: per-band masked RMSE and SSE; geometry-defined occluded and height-sensitive zones; no label-defined zone enters inputs; terrain-cluster paired bootstrap1000
phase2.evidence_threshold: Existing-input predictability: >=5% reduction of confirmation occluded SSE with paired95%CI lower>0 and beats shuffled control. Added-descriptor increment: same threshold vs same-input probe. These are diagnostic decisions, not promotion for the1dB goal.
phase2.interpretation: Positive existing-input result demonstrates missed learnable signal for the evaluated distribution. Added-descriptor result identifies representation loss within published inputs. Negative results cannot establish information-theoretic insufficiency.

phase3.privileged_control: Only diagnostic: calibrate cross-band residual relation on calibration terrains and evaluate confirmation. This measures how much residual is shared with an additional observation, not whether the original input is sufficient.
phase3.limits: No true original mesh, actual continuous TX, or pre-interpolation powers are available. Cannot directly intervene on those hidden quantities; do not pretend a proxy replaces that control.

constraints: No long training or model search, no new propagation simulations, no official score claim. CPU for diagnostic fits. GPU3 exactUUID only if frozen inference needed.
